notes.title: Замена E3: Датирована летняя презентация Summer Game Fest 2024 с анонсами и новыми трейлерами
notes.notes: Продюсер Summer Game Fest Джефф Кейли объявил, что в этом году открывающая ивент презентация состоится 8 июня в 00:00 по Москве.

notes.title: Free Shadow Costume for Sonic
notes.notes: In celebration of the announcement of Sonic X Shadow Generations, download the free ‘Shadow Costume for Sonic’ in Sonic Superstars! The costume can be played during character selection by choosing Sonic when playing Story Mode.

notes.title: Sonic Superstars – Patch Ver. 1.0.1.5
notes.notes:
Update ver. 1.0.1.5 for Sonic Superstars is live now! This update offers bug fixes and the option to reset Time Attack scores. Please be sure to download before playing Sonic Superstars.

*This Time Attack score reset feature will reset only your own score on the local save data. Scores shown on “Top Rank” will not be affected by this.

notes.title: SONIC SUPERSTARS - FREE Sonic Holiday Costume
notes.notes: Sonic Superstars is available now! Grab those Chaos Emeralds and get ready to power up with Sonic and friends! Explore the mysterious Northstar Islands solo or multiplayer and thwart Dr. Eggman's latest evil plans!

notes.title: Update ver. 1.0.0.8
notes.notes:
We've heard your feedback and are pleased to announce the release of update ver. 1.0.0.8 
This update removes the need to login with an Epic Games account to access Online Battle Mode. 
Stay tuned to this space for future updates.

notes.title: Update About Cross-Platform Play in Online Battle Mode
notes.notes: Today, we are releasing a patch that moves the Epic Game account login prompt from appearing at game startup to only appearing when a player starts online Battle Mode. This login is currently required to play in online Battle Mode on Steam. You should no longer see the prompt once you have synched your Epic and Steam accounts. Stay tuned to this space for future updates.

notes.title: A Note About Cross-Platform Play in Online Battle Mode
notes.notes: We have heard your feedback and are working on a solution so that the Epic Games account login prompt that enables cross-platform online play in Battle Mode will no longer appear at game startup. We will update this space when we have more information to share.

notes.title: Sonic Superstars is Available Now!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=MsL9pKdJ1A8;full][/previewyoutube]

Adventure through the mystical Northstar Islands in this all-new take on classic 2D Sonic high-speed action platforming. Play as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, and Amy and harness all-new Emerald powers to move and attack in dynamic new ways. Navigate gorgeous, never-before-seen environments solo or with up to 3 other players and stop Dr. Eggman, Fang, and a mysterious new adversary from converting the islands’ giant animals into Badniks before it’s too late! 

-A new Spin on a Classic: The 2D Sonic high-speed sidescrolling action platforming you know and love, reimagined with fully 3D graphics, new powers and abilities, an all-new setting, and new ways to play! You’ve never played classic Sonic like this before!

-Play as your Favorite Characters: Choose from Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, and Amy and take advantage of their unique abilities to blaze a path across the Northstar Islands as they race to defeat Dr. Eggman, who has teamed up with an old nemesis, Fang, and a mysterious new armored adversary. 

-All-New Powers and Abilities: Harness the power of the Chaos Emeralds to multiply, swim up waterfalls, slow time, uncover hidden secrets, and more!

-More Friends, More Fun: For the first time ever in a Sonic game, play through the entire campaign with up to 3 other players with drop-in and drop-out 4-Player Local Co-op.

-Challenge Players From Around the World: Compete locally or online with up to 8 players in the all-new Battle Mode!

notes.title: Sonic Superstars Launches October 17th! Pre-Order Now!
notes.notes:

Play with up to three other players in drop-in and drop-out local co-op or challenge up to seven players online or three players locally in the new Battle Mode. Navigate gorgeous, never-before-seen environments and stop Dr. Eggman, Fang, and a mysterious new adversary from converting the islands’ giant animals into Badniks before it’s too late!
